entities.summary: Yulia Kornievets is a Ukrainian footballer who plays as a striker. She previously played in Russia for Zorky Krasnogorsk and Mordovochka Saransk, and in Ukraine for Lehenda Chernihiv, with which she has also played the European Cup. She is a member of the Ukrainian national team. Yulia Kornievets was a athletes & competitors from Zaporizhzhia (b. 1986-08-31, Zaporizhzhia). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
